snippets.snippet_text: "I certainly don't recommend purchasing anything from this company because you can't take a complaint to a real person directly by phone, email or text. I was scammed in relation to a supplement I bought & there was just no way to quickly query this without going through a ridiculous procedure. Furthermore, ETSY should vet these supplement sellers before accrediting them - in this case it was a bogus company not located in the country ETSY said it was; the product was not sent from the country ETSY said it would be; & the parcel labels showed it was sent from China while the parcel tracking showed it was en route from Thailand (which it wasn't!)."

"I made an order for a leather jacket with Etsy, by a \"company\" called LeatherWorkNY, and I paid 160usd or 140euros. The sellers name is Zahida. I payed my order on 07/02/2026 and I never received anything from them! Etsy is a fraud, don't fall for their lies!"

"Had a horrible experience with etsy. Ordered a gold chain. Received delivery date and then few hours later told that order was cancelled. No reason given- asked to contact the seller. Sorry but do not have time for that !! Thankfully have been refunded. Avoid this company as their average review score is 1.5!!. Should have checked before I ordered"

possible_subjects: Etsy Trustpilot reviews page 2 (April 4, 2026): supplement misdeclared origin from China/Thailand; leather jacket non-delivery $160 ordered February 7, 2026; gold chain order cancelled without explanation
